final.title: Final Server
final.description:
Default dns server tag.
The first server will be used if empty.

strategy.description: Default domain strategy for resolving the domain names.

independent_cache.description: Make each DNS server's cache independent for special purposes. If enabled, will slightly degrade performance.

cache_capacity.title: LRU cache capacity.
cache_capacity.description: Value less than 1024 will be ignored.

optimistic.description: Enable optimistic DNS caching. When a cached DNS entry has expired but is still within the timeout window, the stale response is returned immediately while a background refresh is triggered. Conflict with `disable_cache` and `disable_expire`. When set to `true`, the default timeout of `3d` is used.

timeout.description:
The maximum time an expired cache entry can be served optimistically.
`3d` is used by default.
Default timeout for each DNS query. `10s` is used by default. Can be overridden by `rules.[].timeout` (DNS rule action) or `domain_resolver.timeout`.

reverse_mapping.description: Stores a reverse mapping of IP addresses after responding to a DNS query in order to provide domain names when routing. Since this process relies on the act of resolving domain names by an application before making a request, it can be problematic in environments such as macOS, where DNS is proxied and cached by the system.

server_port.description: NTP server port. 123 is used by default.
server_port.title: Port

interval.description: Time synchronization interval. 30 minutes is used by default.

final.description: Default outbound tag. The first outbound will be used if empty.

auto_detect_interface.description: Bind outbound connections to the default NIC by default to prevent routing loops under tun. Only supported on Linux, Windows and macOS. Takes no effect if outbound.bind_interface is set.

override_android_vpn.description: Accept Android VPN as upstream NIC when auto_detect_interface enabled. Only supported on Android.

default_interface.description: Bind outbound connections to the specified NIC by default to prevent routing loops under tun. Only supported on Linux, Windows and macOS. Takes no effect if auto_detect_interface is set.

default_mark.description: Set routing mark by default. Only supported on Linux. Takes no effect if outbound.routing_mark is set.

find_process.description: Enable process search for logging when no process_name, process_path, package_name, user or user_id rules exist. Only supported on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

find_neighbor.description: Enable neighbor resolution for logging when no source_mac_address or source_hostname rules exist. Only supported on Linux and macOS.

default_http_client.description: Tag of the default HTTP Client used by remote rule-sets. If empty and http_clients is defined, the first HTTP client is used.

default_domain_resolver.description: DNS server tag to use for resolving domain names in outbounds and endpoints. Can be overridden by outbound.domain_resolver.

default_network_strategy.description: Default network strategy for outbound connections. Takes no effect if outbound.bind_interface, outbound.inet4_bind_address or outbound.inet6_bind_address is set. Conflicts with default_interface.

default_fallback_delay.description: Default fallback delay for network strategy.

ip_version.description: 4 (A DNS query) or 6 (AAAA DNS query).  Not limited if empty.

interface.description:
List of network interface names to send mDNS queries on.
 When empty, all interfaces that are up, multicast-capable, and non-loopback are used.

x-tag.title: Tag
x-tag.description: Purely cosmetic value to use through UI, will NOT be used in final config

managed.description: Enable this when the inbound is managed by the SSM API for dynamic user.

max_early_data.description: Allowed payload size is in the request. Enabled if not zero.

early_data_header_name.description: Early data is sent in path instead of header by default. To be compatible with Xray-core, set this to Sec-WebSocket-Protocol. It needs to be consistent with the server.

default.description: The default outbound tag. The first outbound will be used if empty.

2 is used by default.

interval.description: The test interval. 3m will be used if empty.

tolerance.description: The test tolerance in milliseconds. 50 will be used if empty.

idle_timeout.description: The default outbound tag. The first outbound will be used if empty.

interrupt_exist_connections.description: Interrupt existing connections when the selected outbound has changed. Only inbound connections are affected by this setting, internal connections will always be interrupted.
